Book correction: The table prints the range of \operatorname{sech}^{-1} x as (0, \infty[, with mixed brackets that leave out 0. But \operatorname{sech}^{-1} 1 = \ln\left(\dfrac{1 + 0}{1}\right) = \ln 1 = 0 so 0 is a value of the function. The correct range is [0, \infty) (that is, [0, \infty[), the same as the restricted domain of \operatorname{sech} x, just like \cosh^{-1} x.
